bullets.text: The system shall allow users to create 3D parametric models.
Allow users to navigate and rotate 3D views of a model for interactive visualization
The system shall allow users to access the Feature Manager Design Tree for viewing and managing design history.
Create 3D parametric models with user-defined parameters and visualization options
Provide a feature to manage and view design history in the Feature Manager Design Tree
Users must be able to navigate to the SolidWorks welcome screen, allowing them to access the application and start working on projects.
Users must be able to select an existing project from the welcome screen, enabling them to easily access and manage their existing projects.
Users can create new Part files, allowing for the creation of 3D models and simulations.
Create new Part, Assembly, and Drawing files
Implement file creation with appropriate extensions
Ensure file types are correctly identified and handled
The system shall display a Command Manager with main drawing and editing tools.
The system shall provide access to additional options through panels divided into sections.
The system shall enable users to set document-specific properties, including units and display preferences.
The system shall offer an option to select a dark theme for the application interface.
The system shall allow users to configure dimension display settings such as style, break lines, and tolerance in the Document Properties dialog.
The system shall allow users to initiate sketching operations within a Part project environment.
The system shall allow users to access a Sketch section containing tools for creating 2D geometric entities.
The system shall allow users to select a sketch plane from a list or preview before initiating the creation of 2D entities.
The system shall allow users to draw 2D geometric sketches on the Top Plane.
The system shall provide a Line tool for creating straight segments in sketches.
The system shall allow users to recall the latest sketch tool and reapply it.
The system shall allow users to create a spline curve by defining multiple nodes and confirming the last node with a double-click.
The system shall allow users to create an arc by specifying two points for the radius and a third point to define the arc length.
Allow users to create circles by clicking two distinct points on the screen.
Provide an option to create ellipses by clicking three points on the screen, with the option to save the ellipse as a custom shape.
The system shall allow users to create rectangles by clicking two opposite corners.
Introduce a new feature to create rectangles by clicking two opposite corners on the screen, with the option to save the rectangle as a custom shape.
The system shall allow users to create 2D geometric sketches using straight segments.
The system shall provide access to additional drawing modes through a dropdown menu associated with each main 2D tool.
The system shall allow users to adjust drawing properties, such as the number of sides for a polygon, via the Property Manager on the left side.
Drawing modes can be selected via a dropdown menu.
Contextual tips appear when hovering over drawing buttons.
The system shall provide real-time measurement feedback for sketch entities such as length and radius during drawing.
The system shall enable snapping functionality to facilitate precise alignment of sketch elements with existing geometry.
Users can perform actions (e.g. zoom, pan, rotate) on the sketch without losing any data.
Display dashed guidelines for perpendicular and tangent relationships.
The system shall allow users to define relationships between sketch entities using special cursor symbols or side indicators.
The system shall allow users to identify sketch entities as part of a single 2D Sketch.
Create a 2D sketch with geometric entities (lines, circles) and allow users to define relationships between sketch entities.
Allow users to toggle the display of key geometric points (endpoints, midpoints, centers) by holding down the CTRL key.
The system shall allow users to zoom in and out using the mouse wheel.
The system shall allow users to pan around the sketch by holding down CTRL and using arrow keys.
The system shall allow users to exit the Sketch mode by pressing CTRL+Q.
Add CTRL + arrow key panning in Sketch mode.
The system shall enable users to select a sketch from the Feature Manager, allowing for efficient navigation and management of sketches.
The system shall allow users to move a selected sketch using arrow keys or directional controls.
The system shall allow users to scale a selected sketch by manipulating its nodes.
The system shall provide a basic drawing experience, enabling users to draw geometric entities in a new 2D sketch.
The system shall allow users to double-click on a sketch to enter edit mode.
The system shall allow users to select geometric entities such as points, lines, and curves using the cursor.
The system shall allow users to access and modify entity properties through a Property Manager interface.
Develop cursor-based selection of geometric entities.
Create a Property Manager interface for entity modification.
Provide a feature that allows users to specify the length of sketch entities, enabling precise control over their size and shape.
Offer a feature that enables users to define the inclination angle of sketch entities, facilitating the creation of 3D-like models or animations.
Define a system that enables users to create and manage relationships between 2D sketch entities, allowing for efficient data manipulation and analysis.
The system shall allow users to [[resize]] sketches by dragging their sides or circular entities.
The system shall enable users to define sketch elements as construction geometry.
Provide a dialog box for sketch constraints and options
Users can enable Smart Dimension mode to enable advanced dimensioning features.
The system shall allow users to select sketch entities such as points, sides, and curves using the mouse or keyboard.
The system shall allow users to move sketch entities while preserving their geometric relationships.
Advanced 2D sketching tools, such as snap-to-grid, snap-to-edges, and snap-to-vertices, shall be integrated into the Sketch section for precise control and manipulation.
Users can navigate and manipulate sketch entities (e.g., lines, rectangles, triangles) within the Sketch section, while maintaining their geometric relationships.
The system shall permit selection of individual entities while holding down the CTRL key.
The system shall enable the application of sketch tools to groups of entities.
Enable sketch tool application to groups of entities
Allow selection of multiple sides by dragging over them
The system shall allow users to rotate a group of selected sketch entities around the defined center point.
The system shall allow users to verify selected entities and applied relations in a sketch before executing rotation.
Define a single feature for "Sketch Entity Centering" that allows users to:
The system shall allow users to create sketches parallel to any plane or oriented across multiple planes.
The system shall provide identical drawing tools for both 2D and 3D sketches.
The system shall allow users to select a specific plane for sketch creation within the 3D environment.
Users can create sketches on planes that are not limited to the standard orthogonal views.
The system shall allow users to right-click a sketch element and select 'Rotate View' for an interactive 3D preview.
The system shall allow users to click and drag the mouse to rotate the view in 3D space.
Add escape key to exit rotate view mode
The system shall provide an Orientation dialog that enables users to select and orient specific views.
Users can change the coordinate system within the Orientation dialog (e.g. swap XZ/Y, XY/Z, etc.).
The system shall default to using XZ as the ground plane and Y for depth in its coordinate system.
The system can switch the ground plane and depth axis in the Orientation dialog.
The system shall allow users to switch between 2D sketching and 3D sketching modes based on the current view.
The system shall indicate the active reference plane with a visual cursor in 3D view mode.
Users can exit a sketch by pressing CTRL+Q and save the current state of the sketch.
Users can create an independent 3D Sketch after exiting a sketch by saving the current state of the sketch.
Users can edit entities within 3D Sketches, manipulate and rotate 3D Sketch entities, and provide additional options for relations when editing 3D Sketch entities.
Implement CTRL+Q functionality for exiting a 3D sketch
Enable creation of independent 3D sketches after exiting
The system shall enable users to create solid features by sweeping a closed profile along a path using the Property Manager.
The system shall provide guide curves, profiles, and orientation options within the Property Manager for feature creation.
Create 3D objects from 2D sketches using extrusion, revolution, and lofting.
The system shall allow users to create 3D features by extruding 2D sketch entities.
The system shall allow users to adjust extrusion parameters such as direction and extent via a dedicated feature configuration panel.
The system shall visually represent the resulting 3D extruded feature within the 3D workspace.
Users can apply or confirm extrusion operations using a right-click context menu or a green checkmark button.
Apply or confirm extrusion via context menu or button
The system shall allow users to edit 2D sketches, and automatically update associated 3D features based on those modifications.
Implement Revolved feature to generate 3D objects from 2D sketches
Ensure bidirectional synchronization between 2D sketches and 3D features
The system shall provide a user interface for selecting a line to define the axis of revolution.
The system shall enable the selection of a 2D sketch entity to be used as the contour for revolution.
The system shall offer adjustable properties for the revolution, including angle and direction, accessible through a user interface.
Users can adjust revolution properties such as angle and direction via the left-hand panel.
Users can select an entity (e.g. section, floor, etc.) as a section for sweeping operations.
The system shall allow users to define the order in which profiles are connected during lofting.
Users can adjust and customize extrusion parameters (e.g. size, direction, speed) using directional arrows.
Users can modify and reorganize subcomponents (e.g. bones, joints, muscles) of a 3D model to reshape the entire object.
Users can select and customize various facial features (e.g. eyes, nose, mouth) from a 3D model.
The system shall provide a toggle feature for preview modes.
Users can configure scene settings (e.g. lighting, environment, materials) to tailor the visual representation.
Users can save a part file with a specific file extension (.[[sldprt]]) to preserve the visual representation.
Users can switch between different preview modes (e.g. 2D, 3D, Real-World) to enhance the viewing experience.
Create file save functionality with .[[sldprt]] extension
The system shall allow users to create and save SOLIDWORKS parts with the .[[sldprt]] file extension.
The system shall allow users to open a new assembly project from the New menu.
The system shall allow users to import existing components into an assembly project.
Import existing components into assembly projects
The system shall allow users to insert a selected component into an assembly by placing it within the graphics area.
Users can select any component except a reference part for manipulation.
The system shall provide a right-click context menu option named 'Edit Part' to enable users to modify component features and sketches.
The system shall enforce the saving of Assembly projects in a .[[sldasm]] file format upon initial creation.
Users must be able to navigate to the "Edit Part" menu within the Assembly component.
Require saving projects in .[[sldasm]] format for the first time
The system shall enable users to right-click on the first level of an assembly and select 'Edit Assembly' to return to editing mode.
The system shall allow users to assign an appearance/material that affects the entire part, not individual sketches or features within it.
Implement right-click context menu for first level of assembly to trigger 'Edit Assembly' action.
The system shall allow users to select and modify the appearance of individual model components within a scene.
Create a hexagonal shape with a specified number of sides (6) and a specified number of sides (6).
Select and modify the color of a shape border, allowing for 5 different color options and the ability to change the color of a shape border.
The system shall allow users to select and modify the color of shape borders.
Apply and modify border colors for shapes
Implement nested outline functionality for shapes
